title: Cache-oblivious algorithm
key_contribution: Overview of cache-oblivious algorithm theory including the ideal-cache model and known optimal algorithms for matrix transposition, sorting, and FFT.

title: Cache-Oblivious Scheduling of Streaming Applications
key_contribution: Proved that recursive partitioning of streaming pipelines achieves asymptotically optimal cache miss count without parameterization by cache size.

title: Accelerating GPU Data Processing using FastLanes Compression
key_contribution: Demonstrated that cache-aware blocking of decompression vectors (1024 values) is critical for GPU register pressure, analogous to CPU L1 cache blocking for Base64 decode.
